dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave trailing edge curve following a smooth spline from the apex to the posterior insertion on the dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape classification with a minimal pixel radius at the highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 45-degree angular steepness relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Maximum base width is approximately 1.4 times the maximum vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Large radius convex arc forming a gradual slope along the anterior-dorsal cranial boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, thick beak geometry with visible length approximately equal to the thickness at the melon inflection point.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle where the melon slope transitions into the rostrum base.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Circular indentation or pixel highlight visible on the dorsal-lateral region of the melon.
other_distinctive_markers: Monochromatic cyan luminescence with sharp edge-to-background contrast and low-poly surface rendering.
